annotations.text:
Hold space flips this view to the original, in place.

Flicker-comparing the same position is how a misplaced box becomes obvious. Side-by-side at half width is how it gets missed — which is exactly how both engine bugs survived automated checks.

The failure that matters is invisible.

This page had no text layer, so it was copied through untouched — everything on it is still in the file. A clean-looking summary here would be the most dangerous screen in the product, so the warning outranks the redaction count.

Deep runs 10–15s per page, so redaction is a background job, not a synchronous action.

The model step is named rather than shown as a spinner, because a 20-page return pauses for minutes and an unexplained wait reads as a hang.

This editor exists because TextEdit saves RTF by default, which silently invalidated every rule in a real redact.txt. Writing plain UTF-8 always makes that failure impossible rather than merely diagnosed.

The right rail makes the vocabulary discoverable, and separates what regex can find from what needs the model.
